question:
**Direction: A part of the given sentence which has been underlined may contain a spelling error. Select the option that correctly rectifies the spelling error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Some of the islands in the Bay of Bengal are still **__inaccesible__** to the scientists.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Inaccessible."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is **"inaccessible," **with two** "c's" **and two** "s's."**
 
• The prefix **"in-" **means &q
